system: Scalar paraxial coherent 4f relay: equal input/output disk, finite Fourier-plane aperture, tunable radial phase plate
operator: T(alpha,beta)=K_m M_exp(i*(alpha*r^2+beta*r^4)) K_m, up to fixed imaging parity/convention phase
kernel: K=c sqrt(xy) J_m(cxy), L2(dx); equivalent physical radial L2(r dr) via phi=sqrt(r)g
derivative: Return both T f and partial_alpha T f, sharing the first propagation/input conversion
accuracy: All sampled-input directions bounded by exact finite-matrix kernel residual delta: E <= delta*(||K||+||Khat||) for both phase and alpha derivative. Relative bound uses low-rank composite norm minus E when positive. Analytic continuous-source direct-quadrature audit is separate.
cost: v2: Dense kernel assembly/casting charged to all; compression-only kernel norm and residual/QR checks charged only to compressed methods. Per-phase relative operator-norm gate charged to compressed methods, reusing a prepared core when present. Independent continuous-source audits excluded. Cached-kernel factor action, full response refresh, low-rank value action and core refresh all allowed. Totals are phase-sum workload estimates, not a continuous end-to-end stopwatch. No matrix-free cold preparation claim.
confirmation: After pilot, same largest case, five fresh processes, randomized method order. Each process is one paired sample; repeated hot calls only estimate one time.
scope: Synthetic radial phase plate in a physical 4f architecture. No replication of a published device, full high-NA vector model or measured optical data. Keep prior affine negative results.
